about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Kirsten E. Gillibrand

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HOUSE BILLS
statements.title: HOUSE BILLS
sentences: Madam President, notwithstanding rule XXII, I ask unanimous consent that the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation be discharged from further consideration of H.R. 4624 and the Senate proceed to the immediate consideration of it and H.R. 973, which was received from the House and is at the desk, en bloc.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE REMOVAL OF UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN THAT HAVE NOT BEEN AUTHORIZED BY CONGRESS--Motio
statements.title: DIRECTING THE REMOVAL OF UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM HOSTILITIES WITHIN OR AGAINST THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN THAT HAVE NOT BEEN AUTHORIZED BY CONGRESS--Motion to Discharge
sentences: Mr. President, pursuant to 50 U.S.C. 1546(a) and in accordance with section 601(b) of the International Security Assistance and Arms Export Control Act, I move to discharge the Committee on Foreign Relations from further consideration of S.J. Res. 181.
Mr. President, I rise in support of my legislation to end President Trump's unauthorized, illegal war with Iran.
We were told that Iran's nuclear program would be eliminated.
Instead, Iran still holds nuclear material, and its leaders may be more determined than ever to build a weapon.
We were told that the Iranian regime would crumble; instead, it now holds new leverage of the world's energy supply in the Strait of Hormuz.
Pouring billions of tax dollars into an open-ended war in Iran.
This reckless war is driving up monthly bills and making everyday life harder for working families.
She served this country courageously and honorably for more than 6 years before she was killed in an Iranian attack in Jordan.
The President's war with Iran is a betrayal of that obligation.
I urge my colleagues to vote yes on this resolution.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SAFEGUARD AMERICAN VOTER ELIGIBILITY ACT--Resumed
statements.title: SAFEGUARD AMERICAN VOTER ELIGIBILITY ACT--Resumed
sentences: The President is more focused on preventing Americans from voting than in lowering prices for working families who are suffering right now because of his economy and because of Trump's tariffs.
Make no mistake, the SAVE America Act is not about preventing voter fraud.
This legislation would virtually eliminate voter registration methods that 90 percent of Americans rely on.
That includes mail-in registration, online registration, voter registration drives, and automatic registration at the DMV.

The newest version of this bill also ends mail-in and absentee voting, with very limited exceptions, putting up a massive barrier to people's ability to vote if they work during the day or otherwise can't make it to the polls in person.
The SAVE America Act would also force States to submit voter data to the Department of Homeland Security under the guise of verifying voter citizenship status.
If you take out your wallet and find your identification, it is going to be a driver's license.
The SAVE America Act would effectively block us from voting if you don't have a passport or didn't go to get a new birth certificate with your married name on it.
All of these American citizens would be disenfranchised by the SAVE America Act.
It is already illegal for noncitizens to vote in our elections, and numerous studies have confirmed that voting by noncitizens is extremely rare.
The President himself said that, by passing the SAVE America Act, the GOP will ``never lose a race for 50 years.'' What do you think President Trump meant by that?
I urge my colleagues to vote no on the SAVE America Act.
We will not let them get away with that.

statements.title: NATIONAL HISTORICAL PARK AND NATIONAL HISTORIC LANDMARK ESTABLISHMENT AND BOUNDARY ADJUSTMENTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: I urge the unanimous consent for this extraordinary piece of legislation.
Mr. President, I rise to support our legislation, which I just spoke on, about Fort Ontario.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: Madam President, I rise in support of amendment No. 3759, the Comprehensive Operations for Unmanned-System Neutralization and Threat Elimination Response Act, or the COUNTER Act.
I urge my colleagues to vote for this amendment to strengthen our national security and protect our military facilities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: I rise today to reiterate my colleagues' clarification that the express congressional intent of section 9 of the GENIUS Act, as amended, is to ensure that FinCen shall issue guidance and notice and comment rulemaking.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GENIUS Act (Executive Session)
statements.title: GENIUS Act (Executive Session)
sentences: Mr. President, I rise in support of the Hagerty- Gillibrand substitute amendment to the GENIUS Act, legislation to regulate the cryptocurrency assets known as stablecoins.
They repeatedly called on Congress to regulate stablecoins, recognizing their global role in the global economy.

To date, Congress's failure to act has left the digital asset space as a Wild West, where American consumers are vulnerable to scams, and businesses are desperate for the regulatory clarity they need to compete with foreign countries, foreign entities that do business in our markets effectively.
In 2023, the European Union passed comprehensive cryptocurrency regulation, and numerous meaningful provisions went into effect last year.
China's central bank has been promoting the digital yuan, which threatened the U.S. dollar's role as the global reserve currency.
Global commerce will soon be conducted using stablecoins.
It is imperative to keep the U.S. dollar as the global reserve currency of the world and stablecoins to be pegged to the dollar, not the Chinese yuan.
Stablecoins offer faster, more affordable ways to settle transactions that will benefit everyone.

Earlier this year, Senators Hagerty, Alsobrooks, Scott, Lummis, and I introduced the bipartisan GENIUS Act, which is the strongest effort to date to regulate and create a clear regulatory framework for the payment stablecoin industry.
Many of those Americans have found access to the capital markets and access to capital through cryptocurrency and blockchain technologies.

This stablecoin bill represents the first incident that we are trying to make access to capital a reality for more Americans, to have our safety and soundness rules, our know your customer rules, our illicit finance rules, our protections of a one-to-one dollar banking.
If you could see a document itemizing every change that has been made since the minute we introduced this bill, it is volumes long.

statements.title: Senate
sentences: So I was in New York yesterday, and we talked about these cuts to Social Security.
I have to say, I was stopped by a gentleman who worked at Amtrak and said: Madam Senator, Madam Senator, I just want to thank you for protecting my Social Security.

But I am telling you, Senator Booker, when Elon Musk starts firing people in Social Security and tells the Social Security Administration, ``You cannot answer the phone,'' what are our mothers and fathers and grandmothers and grandfathers supposed to do?
And, worse, Elon Musk is expecting them to show up in person at a Social Security office.
How many of our older Americans feel uncomfortable getting in the subway to get to a Social Security Administration because there are stairs or because the lighting is not good enough?
These are the challenges that our older Americans have, and so I just want to talk about the things you told us last night about the risk to Social Security.
Social Security is our seniors' money.
For a lot of older Americans, that Social Security check is the only money they have for that month.
Who is he to tell America how to run its Social Security Administration when our seniors need those checks?
Seven thousand staff, even though the Social Security Administration staffing is already at a 50-year low.
Tax cuts for billionaire buddies of Elon Musk.
Hands off our Social Security, Elon Musk and President Trump.
They are rallying all across the country to say: Hands off my Social Security, hands off my Medicare, hands off my Medicaid.
And I don't think people should stand for it because your Social Security check is your hard-earned money.
It is not for Elon Musk to play with, to shift around, or send it to tax breaks for his billionaire friends.

You know, every time you get a paycheck, Senator Booker, there is a line that says Social Security because that money has been taken out of your paycheck and put into Social Security so it is there for you when you retire.
The pages sitting here right here, you are paying into your Social Security.
So if you need help because your Social Security didn't arrive, then how are you supposed to get that check?
Ultimately, cutting individuals from Social Security doesn't just affect them; it affects the entire economy.
So you can imagine if all our seniors are getting this Social Security benefit, you can't go then buy your groceries.
Social Security, if you didn't know it, is our country's largest anti-poverty program.
When we designed Social Security, however many decades ago, it was so that our seniors don't die in poverty, because they were dying.
And so we created Social Security.
They are just cutting everything because they want to make space for these tax cuts for their billionaire buddies.

You have the incursions in New Jersey and incursions in New York at the same time, and we don't have assurance that those drones aren't being operated by China or Russia or Iran or another adversary for a nefarious purpose.
This is about making massive cuts for tax breaks for billionaires because that is where they want to spend your tax dollars--New Yorkers' tax dollars and New Jerseyans' tax dollars.
They want to take it and give it as tax breaks to billionaires.
Good government is important, and I support efficiency.
So this is something we are going to get to the bottom of.
